test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A person crosses an 1800-metre long street in 6 minutes. The speed of the person in km/h is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 1800 m

Time = 6 min 

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

1 min = 60 sec

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ (1800/6 × 60) m/sec

⇒ 5 m/sec

The speed of person in km/h = (5 × 18/5) 

⇒ 18 km/h

**∴ Required speed of man is 18**
